name: Oba Netori ~Otto no Shiranai Midara na Kankei~
original_name: 叔母寝取り ～夫の知らない淫らな関係～
source:
Rieko Momose the protagonist's aunt.
Tender and matronly, like a true mother always doting on him.
She's fond of him but never thought of him "that way".
Her relationship with her husband is healthy. They have a daughter.
She's also incredibly sensual, giving off vibes that attract other men...
... while her husband seems blissfully ignorant of her needs. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE174300.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
百濑理惠子是主人公的姨妈。

她温柔而慈爱，像真正的母亲一样总是宠爱主人公。

她喜欢主人公，却从未以那种方式想过他。

她与丈夫的关系很健康，两人育有一个女儿。

她也极其性感，散发着吸引其他男人的气息……

而她的丈夫似乎完全没有意识到她的需求。
